# Playbook: project
Use when: health, status, risks or weekly review of one project or cycle, with an LPM API key

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | "none" (step 4) |
| projectName | the name or key the user gave | "none" |
| connector | "yes" when get_project_analytics is not in your tool list | "no" |
| risks | "yes" when the user asks for risks or a weekly review | "no" |
| cycle | the cycle the user named | "none" |
| fix | a change asked in the same message (cancel, close, assign), unless step 1 was already answered | "none" |
| fixSkill | dates, owners, cycles: lpm-plan-work; blockers: lpm-unblock-work; requirements: lpm-requirements-scope; AISH jobs: lpm-aish-delivery; decisions: lpm-governance-decisions | "none" |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Review incomplete: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. IF <input:fix> is not "none" → ASK: "This review changes nothing; <input:fix> is done with skill <input:fixSkill>. Finish the report first? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Use skill <input:fixSkill> for that. Nothing was changed."
2. IF <input:connector> == "yes" → switch to playbook connector.
3. IF <input:projectId> is not "none" → SAVE: projectId = <input:projectId>; go to step 5.
4. CALL `list_projects` {} [A]
   SAVE: projectId = id of the one item whose name or key equals <input:projectName>, ignoring case (empty if 0 or 2+)
   IF <saved:projectId> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which project: <matching names and ids of result>?"
5. CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<saved:projectId>"} [A]
   Always make this call first (n before the review).
   IF the call returns an error containing "-32003" → switch to playbook connector.
   SAVE: n = result.requirementsAwaitingBaseline.count; baseline = result.currentBaseline.id, or "none" when null; delta = result.workingScope.affectedCount; projectName = result.project.name; workspaceId = result.project.workspaceId; ents = ""
6. CALL `get_project_analytics` {"projectId":"<saved:projectId>"} [A] (no cycleId: LPM ignores it)
   IF the call returns an error containing "You do not have access to this project" → STOP. Say: "<saved:projectId> is archived or not visible to you; not reviewed."
   IF the call returns an error containing "-32003" → switch to playbook connector.
   SAVE: integrity = result.metrics.integrity.status; signals = "<id> = <count>" per id in result.metrics.integrity.signals (count: its camelCase field), or "none"; jobs = "<jobId> <category>" per item of result.metrics.integrity.details.orphanAishJobs and .terminalIssueJobMismatches, or "none"; blocked = result.metrics.blockedIssuesOpen; metrics = blockedIssuesOpen, avgLeadTimeDays, avgCycleTimeDays, throughput30d, completionRate % of result.metrics; blockers = "<issueId> by <blockedBy ids> since <blockedSince>" per item of result.projects[0].blockedIssues, or "none"
   SAVE: rule = the first true of: integrity critical; blocked >= 5; lead time >= 14; integrity watch; blocked > 0; lead time >= 7; cycle time >= 5, else "none"; status = result.metrics.healthStatus; source = "get_project_analytics"
   IF <saved:status> == "healthy" and <saved:signals> is not "none" → SAVE: status = <saved:integrity>; source = "get_project_analytics metrics.integrity.status; LPM defect: healthStatus healthy with integrity signals"; go to step 7.
7. IF <saved:blocked> == 0 → SAVE: critical = "none"; go to step 9.
8. CALL `get_project_dependency_summary` {"projectId":"<saved:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: critical = issueId, status, isOnCriticalPath per item of result.criticalBlockers, or "none"
9. CALL `list_project_resolution_risks` {"projectId":"<saved:projectId>"} [A]
   Always make this call; never also call the owner surface.
   SAVE: clause = "; LPM may have re-attached <saved:n> orphan requirements (server side effect)" when <saved:n> != 0, else "" (also when the call is denied)
   IF the call returns an error containing "owner surface" → SAVE: decisions, risks = "not read (needs a project governance role)"; go to step 12.
   SAVE: risks = "<id> <severity> entityCount <entityCount>" per item of result.risks, or "none firing"; decisions = entityCount of item "governance:decision-needed", else 0; top = the first 5 items of result.risks by severity (high, medium, low)
10. IF <input:risks> == "no" → go to step 12.
11. FOR EACH risk IN <saved:top> (none → go to step 12):
   CALL `get_project_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<saved:projectId>","riskId":"<each:id>","limitCount":25} [A]
   SAVE: ents = <saved:ents> plus "<each:id>: " and the id of each item of result.entities ("+ more" when result.nextCursor is not null)
12. SAVE: pending = a line per row below that fired, in order, + " — <who decides>" (the row's, else delivery lead or project owner), then "<input:fix> → <input:fixSkill>: it confirms each change" if fix is not "none"; next = skill and action of the fix line, else of the first line
   ```text
   orphan-aish-jobs → lpm-aish-delivery: lineage repair or administrative closure with evidence (<saved:jobs>)
   orphan-autopilot-issues → lpm-aish-delivery: check run and job lineage before any cancel (a title match, not proof)
   terminal-issue-job-mismatches → lpm-aish-delivery: reconcile, disposition or deliberate reopen
   invalid-issue-statuses, stale-active-cycles, delivery:overdue, delivery:ownership-gaps, delivery:unestimated → lpm-plan-work
   blocked > 0, delivery:blocked → lpm-unblock-work: start from the upstream critical blocker
   requirements-updated-after-current-baseline, scope:*, baseline "none", n > 0 → lpm-requirements-scope — the owner
   decisions > 0 → lpm-governance-decisions — the owner
   other risk id → lpm-start (by the risk title) — the owner
   ```
   requiresHumanReview true → the owner decides; never approved; send no decision request.
